_comment: 'enabled' is the shipped default: tier 1 and 2 with a working source.
Tier 3 ships off - switch it on in the app's Firms picker or here.
Entries with a 'note' and no token were investigated and have no scriptable
board; they are kept so you can see they were considered rather than missed.

companies.name: Apple
companies.note: Read from jobs.apple.com, filtered to the Students/Internships team. search=intern is useless here — it matches retail roles — so the team filter is what isolates internships. Replaces the Simplify feed, which had 12 rows against Apple's ~51.

companies.name: Citadel
companies.note: Citadel and Citadel Securities are separate firms sharing one careers platform, so each needs its own entry — 12 early-career roles are only on citadel.com, 18 only on citadelsecurities.com. They do cross-list their campus programmes at the same path on both hosts; those collapse to one row rather than appearing twice.

companies.name: Citadel Securities
companies.note: The market-making side, a separate firm from Citadel with its own roles (FPGA, DMM trading, rates). Campus programmes cross-listed on both hosts are shown once, under Citadel.

companies.name: Google
companies.note: Read from google.com/about/careers directly. Two server-side slices — employment_type=INTERN and target_level=EARLY — because the whole board is thousands of roles at 20 a page. Replaces the Simplify feed, whose three Google rows had all gone dead.

companies.name: Hudson River Trading
companies.note: Sourced from HRT's own site via its jobs sitemap. Its public Greenhouse board (hrttalentcommunity) is a talent-community placeholder holding three generic entries, not the real roles.

companies.name: Jane Street
companies.note: Jane Street's Greenhouse board (janestreet) is experienced hires only — 177 roles, no internships. Students and new grads come from the JSON its own careers page reads.

companies.name: Meta
companies.note: metacareers.com posts to a GraphQL endpoint needing an fb_dtsg session token. The Simplify feed has entries, but metacareers.com returns 400 to scripted callers so no link can be confirmed — leads only. Set enabled=true to take them anyway; they arrive flagged as unverified.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.note: gcsservices.careers.microsoft.com refuses scripted connections. Sourced from the Simplify/Pitt CSC community feed instead. Thin but the links verify 200 (2026-08-03).

companies.name: Nvidia
companies.note: Workday pages 20 at a time, so 'query' keeps this board from dominating a run.

companies.name: Optiver
companies.note: Their listing renders 16 roles per category page and loads the rest with JavaScript; there is no API, sitemap or page parameter, so this gets the newest 16 of each category rather than every posting.

companies.name: Arrowstreet
companies.note: Arrowstreet splits its Workday tenant: the Arrowstreet site is experienced hires, Campus_Careers is the internships.

companies.name: ExodusPoint
companies.note: Its Greenhouse board holds two signposts — 'Investment - ExodusPoint Jobs Page' and 'Non-Investment - Referral' — rather than roles, and exoduspoint.com lists nothing and gives an email address. Off, because two non-jobs in the table is worse than an absent firm.

companies.name: Marshall Wace
companies.note: Marshall Wace's Greenhouse board (marshallwace) carries a single Recruitment Assistant posting. The internships live as pages on mwam.com and are read from its internships sitemap.

companies.name: Maven Securities
companies.note: mavensecurities.com/careers 404s and no ATS fingerprint was found (rechecked 2026-08-07).

companies.name: Quantlab
companies.note: Its board is Jobvite (jobs.jobvite.com/quantlab/search?nl=1), which had no open roles when checked on 2026-08-07 — so there is nothing to read yet rather than nothing to read from.

companies.name: Aurora
companies.note: greenhouse/aurorainnovation 404s and aurora.tech renders its board client-side with no ATS fingerprint (checked 2026-08-04).

companies.name: BlackRock
companies.note: Job search returns 403 to scripted callers.

companies.name: Bloomberg
companies.note: careers.bloomberg.com returns 403 to scripted callers; needs a browser.

companies.name: Bridgewater
companies.note: Careers page returns 403 to scripted callers and exposes no ATS host.

companies.name: Cisco
companies.note: Runs on Phenom People — no adapter for it yet.

companies.name: Goldman Sachs
companies.note: Runs on Avature (recruiting360.avature.net) — no adapter for it yet.

companies.name: JPMorgan Chase
companies.note: Runs on Oracle HCM (jpmc.fa.oraclecloud.com) — no adapter for it yet.

companies.name: Plaid
companies.note: Runs on RippleMatch — no adapter for it yet.

companies.name: Tesla
companies.note: Own careers API behind a 403 for scripted callers.
